parts.label: (a)
parts.text: 10 people are to be chosen, to receive concert tickets, from a group of 8 men and 6 women.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Find the number of different ways the 10 people can be chosen if 6 of them are men and 4 of
them are women. 
The group of 8 men and 6 women contains a man and his wife.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Find the number of different ways the 10 people can be chosen if both the man and his wife
are chosen or neither of them is chosen. 
13

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Freddie has forgotten the 6-digit code that he uses to lock his briefcase. He knows that he did not
repeat any digit and that he did not start his code with a zero.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Find the number of different 6-digit numbers he could have chosen. 
Freddie also remembers that his 6-digit code is divisible by 5.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Find the number of different 6-digit numbers he could have chosen. 
Freddie decides to choose a new 6-digit code for his briefcase once he has opened it. He plans to
have the 6-digit number divisible by 2 and greater than 600 000, again with no repetitions of digits.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Find the number of different 6-digit numbers he can choose. 
14
